choices.term: τύπος … οὐ μέντοι γε τοῦ πάθους
choices.english: a type of Christ — yet not of his passion
rejected: type of the passion (the common reading Origen is blocking)
choices.why: The whole stretch 1.40–1.49 exists to break pascha/pathos.

pass_a_gloss: Since then [gap]. The sheep is sacrificed by holy ones or Nazirites, but the Savior is sacrificed by lawless and sinners. And that the pascha's sheep is sacrificed by holy ones, the apostle has also said: For also our pascha was sacrificed, Christ. Christ is sacrificed according to the type of the pascha; he is sacrificed by the holy ones, and a type of Christ is the pascha, yet not of his passion.
pass_b_english: Since then [lacuna]. The sheep is sacrificed by holy ones or Nazirites, but the Savior is sacrificed by the lawless and by sinners. And that the sheep of the Passover is sacrificed by holy ones, the apostle has also said: "For our Passover also has been sacrificed, Christ." (1 Corinthians 5:7) Christ is sacrificed according to the type of the Passover. He is sacrificed by the holy ones. And the Passover is a type of Christ — yet not of his passion (Numbers 6:14–17) (Acts 2:23).
